title: freemium feature gates
body:
everything except for the most essential features is locked behind an unreasonably priced subscription. yes, €7/month for what is essentially a clock app is insane. i don’t know why everyone on this platform has these brainworms that they need to pay for everything.
also, offering a watch app in the first place and then making it unusable without a subscription is just insane. 
the only reason i haven’t looked for anything else is because i have a lot of data on this app already. don’t download this, find something else.
